title: Please, step into the urn
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji thought everything was under control, the name that spilled from the captive's lips made his pupils constrict—behind the Second Elder, there was actually an even more terrifying hand manipulating the chess game.

text.content: Moonlight like frost fell upon the abandoned ruins of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. Chen Ji's figure hid among the broken walls and ruins, the Breaking Situation Eye quietly operating, taking in every bit of terrain and every strand of qi within a three-li radius. The trackers thought they had set an inescapable net, but in his eyes it was merely a riddled fishing net full of holes.

dialogue.content: Twelve people, divided into three teams, surrounding in a 品-formation. Chen Ling, hide well later, don't come out.

text.content: Chen Ji raised his hand to gently stroke his sister's hair, the corner of his mouth lifting slightly, though a fierce gleam flickered in his eyes: "Your task is the cleanup. Remember, alive is more useful than dead." He turned around, his black robe billowing in the night wind, and that slender figure beneath the moonlight actually radiated an air of looking down upon the world.

At the eastern side of the ruins, Chen Ji stopped before a broken stele covered in ancient seal characters. Spiritual energy surged from his fingertips as he traced a hidden pattern on its surface—the first node of the complex formation. His thousand years of accumulated experience told him this would be the most lethal trap entrance of the hunting ground.

In the Breaking Situation Eye, the trackers' encirclement was slowly contracting. The leader wore玄-colored combat attire with a bronze sect emblem embroidered on his chest—the mark of the Tianqing Sect Law Enforcement Hall. Chen Ji's gaze flickered, a cold smile forming in his heart: The Second Elder's reach was long indeed, even daring to mobilize the Law Enforcement Hall.

dialogue.content: Since you're here, why not show yourself? Hiding and skulking makes your Law Enforcement Hall seem good only at clandestine dealings.

text.content: His voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly reached every tracker's ears. The next moment, twelve figures darted from the shadows, surrounding him completely. The lead tracker's captain coldly snorted: "Chen Ji, you trespassed the Forbidden Grounds and stole sect secrets—evidence is conclusive! Tonight, you have no escape!"

dialogue.content: "Evidence conclusive?" Chen Ji let out a mocking laugh, his eyes filled with amusement. "I'd like to know who gave you the audacity to use private torture in these ruins? Did your Second Elder tell you what's buried here?"

text.content: The captain's expression shifted slightly, clearly not expecting him to mention the Second Elder. In that split-second moment, the formation flags Chen Ji had prepared in his sleeve suddenly activated—the complex trap formation instantly took shape! Brilliant green light shot skyward, trapping all twelve trackers within the array.

choice.prompt: The formation is complete. Should we interrogate the mastermind first, or eliminate them directly?

choices.text: Courtesy first, then force—interrogation is the priority
choices.description: Give the trackers a chance to see if they're willing to confess the Second Elder's conspiracy, preserving live witnesses to obtain more intelligence.
choices.visible_cost: Consume minimal spiritual energy maintaining the formation
choices.risk_hint: If they refuse to speak, it may waste time
choices.process_label: 陈机sneered："最后一次机会，谁先开口，谁活。"

text.content: The formation's light blazed brilliantly, fierce killing intent肆虐ing within. The trackers' faces filled with terror as they realized they had become the prey. The captain barked: "Chen Ji! You dare! The Second Elder will never forgive you!" Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his tone indifferent: "The Second Elder? He's barely keeping his head above water himself—how could he possibly care about you bunch of discarded pieces?"

choices.text: Kill the chicken to frighten the monkey—execute one person
choices.description: Directly behead one person, using blood and screams to shatter their psychological defenses, letting the rest witness the consequence of defiance.
choices.visible_cost: Consume spiritual energy to condense a killing move
choices.visible_reward: Deterrent effect is overwhelming, enemy morale collapses
choices.risk_hint: May kill an important intelligence source
choices.process_label: 陈机指尖一弹，阵中雷光骤降！

text.content: In a deafening roar, one tracker didn't even have time to scream before turning to ash. Thick blood filled the air, and the remaining eleven were ashen-faced, legs turning to jelly. The captain's pupils contracted violently as he trembled: "You... you're insane!" Chen Ji smiled faintly: "Insane? I'm perfectly clear-headed. Who else wants to try?"

Chen Ling's figure darted from the shadows like a specter, her longsword cold and gleaming. Her movement speed actually exceeded Chen Ji's expectations! In an instant, two trackers had been cut down by her blade, their blood staining the blue stone ground beneath the moonlight.

A hint of surprise flickered in Chen Ji's eyes before his lips curved upward. His sister had hidden her depth well—it seemed during her years with the Holy Sect, she hadn't been idle either. The trackers fell into greater chaos, their originally orderly encirclement instantly crumbling.

dialogue.content: "Brother, I told you I'd help you!"

text.content: Warmth spread through Chen Ji's heart, but there was no time to dwell on it. The Breaking Situation Eye locked onto the strongest spiritual presence within the formation—the captain. His body flickered, shooting through the chaotic battlefield as the spiritual energy in his palm built up, ready to strike.

The captain saw the situation turning against him and turned to flee, but the complex formation held him firmly trapped. In horror, he discovered that no matter which direction he charged, he would collide with fierce formation counterattacks. Chen Ji's figure had approached like the Grim Reaper.

choice.prompt: After capturing the captain alive, how should we deal with this lackey of the Second Elder?

choices.description: Use forbidden arts to forcibly read his memories, obtaining the most complete intelligence, but it will permanently damage his soul.
choices.visible_cost: Consume large amounts of spiritual energy
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the complete evidence chain of the Second Elder's betrayal
choices.risk_hint: May encounter resistance from his soul
choices.process_label: 陈机眼底金光一闪，探手按向队长眉心。

text.content: A sorrowful scream echoed from the captain's spiritual consciousness as memories flooded into Chen Ji's mind like a tide. Secret orders, codes, contact methods... and that gloomy face of the Second Elder. Yet just then, Chen Ji's pupils sharply contracted—he saw another figure in those memories, someone who absolutely should not appear here.

choices.text: Threaten and entice—keep as a witness
choices.description: Use his family's lives and future as leverage, forcing him to confess and testify against the Second Elder, preserving him as a trump card for future counterattack.
choices.visible_reward: Gain a piece that can be manipulated at any time
choices.risk_hint: The other party may comply outwardly while defying orders
choices.process_label: 陈机收起murderous，悠然开口："想活吗？我有个提议。"

text.content: The captain collapsed to the ground, trembling all over. When Chen Ji recited his identity background and family situation, he completely broke down. "I'll talk! I'll tell you everything!" He scrambled to pull out a secret letter from his bosom, "This is the Second Elder's personal order—he wanted me... wanted me to eliminate you!"

Chen Ji took the secret letter and examined it closely. The paper bore the Second Elder's personal seal, and the contents were shocking—not only was there a plan to silence him, but it also involved secret dealings with the Xuanwu Sect and coordinates to an ancient ruin. This wasn't mere betrayal; it was selling the sect for personal gain!

dialogue.content: "Second Elder... what grand ambitions. Unfortunately, you chose the wrong piece."

text.content: Just then, the captain fished out another jade slip from his bosom, trembling: "Th-this is what the Second Elder ordered me to destroy... He said if this fell into Chen Ji's hands, everything would be over!" Chen Ji took the jade slip, his divine sense probing inside, and his pupils suddenly contracted—the contents recorded the origin of the Tianji Record Fragment, along with deliberately erased ancient secrets.

choice.prompt: Facing this jade slip containing the secrets of the Tianji Record, how should Chen Ji handle it?

choices.text: Destroy it immediately, leave no future troubles
choices.description: Since the Second Elder was so eager to destroy it, it poses potential threats. Destroy it and let the truth be buried forever.
choices.visible_cost: May lose the chance to understand his own secrets
choices.visible_reward: Completely eliminate the risk of exposure
choices.process_label: 陈机凝视玉简片刻，spiritual energy已在掌心凝聚。

text.content: Spiritual energy surged as the jade slip emitted tiny cracking sounds. Just as it was about to shatter, Chen Ji suddenly pulled back his hand—the jade slip's inner layer actually contained a hidden formation! Forced destruction would trigger some kind of prohibition. He took a deep breath and stored the jade slip in his sleeve. This thing was far more complex than imagined.

choices.text: Temporarily keep it for future study
choices.description: Since this item is related to the Tianji Record, it may hold the key to unraveling his own secrets. Keep it for now and investigate carefully later.
choices.visible_cost: Carrying it personally may pose risks
choices.visible_reward: Obtain clues to explore the truth of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: May be noticed by those with ulterior motives
choices.process_label: 陈机沉吟片刻，将玉简贴身收好。

text.content: The jade slip felt warm in his hand, with faint pulsations, as if some will was sealed within. Chen Ji's heart stirred—the Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea actually quivered slightly, seemingly responding to this jade slip. He suppressed his urge to investigate and carefully stored the jade slip. Too many mysteries, too few clues—no rush.

Chen Ling sheathed her sword and walked to his side. Her dress was splattered with blood, but her expression was unusually calm. "Brother, should we deal with these people?" Chen Ji surveyed the surroundings; the remaining trackers were already terrified out of their wits, kneeling on the ground trembling.

dialogue.content: Leave one survivor to report back, the rest...废除 their cultivation and dump them at the sect mountain gate. Let the Second Elder see clearly what fate befalls the people he sends.

text.content: Chen Ling received her orders and went on her way, her movements swift and decisive. Chen Ji stood beneath the moonlight with hands clasped behind his back, gazing at the secret letter in his hand and the jade slip hidden close to his body, his eyes flickering with deep meaning. Tonight's game, he had won completely—but that hand behind the Second Elder was the existence truly worthy of vigilance.

The captive's screams gradually faded into the distance. Chen Ji turned to gaze toward the sect. Night wind brushed past, lifting a few strands of black hair at his temples. The warning from the Tianji Record echoed in his mind: the gifts given by fate have long been marked with a price in the dark. And he was walking step by step toward that destined ending.
